## Key facts

- Vadim is CTO at StackLevel Group.
- Century AI Studio is a corporate AI platform for chat, assistants, workflows, documents, structured data, protected integrations, private deployment, access policies, logs and operational review.
- Vadim's focus is governed private AI for regulated organisations, connecting product, architecture, security, adoption and controlled production.
- Vadim's background includes university teaching, programming education and competitive-programming coaching at BSUIR.
